<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append(n['pixels'])
    return {k:sum(v) for k,v in d.items()}
before=snap(current_frame)
action(['LEFT','LEFT'])
def pbox(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
print('player now', pbox(current_frame))
action(['SPACE'])
print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward']})
after=snap(current_frame)
print('before', before)
print('after ', after)
print('player after', pbox(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append(n['pixels'])
    return {k:sum(v) for k,v in d.items()}
before=snap(current_frame)
action(['LEFT','LEFT'])
def pbox(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
print('player now', pbox(current_frame))
action(['SPACE'])
print('result', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','reward']})
